144:114.en: 「Fighting in this world isn't so bad」

144:391.en: 「How sad, that force is the only way.」

144:455.en: 「Perhaps it's our fate to fight, too.」

144:548.en: 「If you notice, can you even dodge?」

144:831.en: 「Surely this isn't the only way\nyou know, is it?」

144:921.en: 「$$シンジ$$'s father...\nOne who rivals the Lilin's king...」

144:997.en: 「You've been crushed by a sad past」

144:1067.en: 「I don't want to become like you」

144:1104.en: 「You'll deny the Lilin to the end」

144:1147.en: 「That hostility...\nThat's the meaning of your existence」

144:1239.en: 「Your fate has been rigged as well」

144:1358.en: 「Humans can't become gods...\nThey have no need to」

144:1411.en: 「Let's cap off all our playing so far」

144:1477.en: 「Let's sync our tempo.\nRemember the piano duet...」

144:1649.en: 「It's a hassle if they get too close.」

144:1742.en: 「Seems no need to go out of our way.」

144:1864.en: 「It really is better with both of us.」

144:1897.en: 「$$シンジ$$...\nYour feelings will be heard someday.」

144:1946.en: 「Let's do what we can right now.」

144:2094.en: 「This time I'll show you my sound.」

144:2289.en: 「You are the hope of the Lilin.」

144:2345.en: 「I won't let anyone disturb the music.」

144:2372.en: 「So each of us gives it our all.」

144:2426.en: 「A solo is nice once in a while.」

144:2526.en: 「Looks like all we can do is give up.」

144:2601.en: 「Nothing to be done. Let's wait for a chance.」

144:2688.en: 「I can't let myself be taken down.」

144:2723.en: 「We're the hope of the Lilin, too.」

144:2793.en: 「Nice! I love the sound with you!」

144:2888.en: 「No matter how often, it's the same.」

144:2930.en: 「It's a slightly unusual\nA.T. Field, isn't it?」

144:3274.en: 「$$シンジ$$'s heart is out of tempo...」

144:3422.en: 「I must protect $$シンジ$$ at any cost...」

144:3494.en: 「As long as we don't give up,\nthere has to be a way...!」

144:3547.en: 「Let's do our best to the end.\nThat's our duty.」

144:3693.en: 「I'm sorry...\nThis wasn't your idea of happiness.」

144:3742.en: 「Just repeat. Same stage, again and again.」

144:3795.en: 「Until you reach a comfy level and funds. That's all.」

144:3893.en: 「Don't make that face. We can resume anytime, $$シンジ$$.」

144:3948.en: 「If players want the world to go on. Till then, farewell.」

144:4033.en: 「Me too, $$シンジ$$. I want to play with you again.」

144:4080.en: 「Super Robot Wars is solo. But watching is fun enough.」

144:4145.en: 「Because I was born to meet you.」

144:4217.en: 「Now... I won't think of the past...!」

144:4283.en: 「I'll change the world in an EVA...!」

144:4322.en: 「I'm not alone...! $$カヲル$$ is with me!」

144:4460.en: 「I'll do what I can for the world...!」

144:4557.en: 「I feel I can do anything with you」

144:4648.en: 「I have no choice but to fight!」
alternatives: I've got no choice but to fight!

144:4696.en: 「I'll stop it by force if I must...!」

144:4752.en: 「I'll at least do what I can...!」

144:4839.en: 「If I have the power to fight...!」

144:4864.en: 「Because this is all I can do...!」

144:5057.en: 「Even if I ram it, I'll stop it!」

144:5111.en: 「I'll do it, even if I'm scared...!」

144:5446.en: 「If we can truly see eye to eye...!」

144:5487.en: 「Unknown or not, a foe is a foe...!」

144:5524.en: 「What is the goal of all this...?」

144:5555.en: 「I'll save them for sure! This time!」

144:5592.en: 「There must be a way...!\nThere has to be something...!」

144:5676.en: 「I understand how you feel,\nbut you can't do this!」

144:5877.en: 「I won't let the world break again!」

144:5910.en: 「The $$サイデリアル$$ are Earth's enemy...!」

144:5947.en: 「If the $$サイデリアル$$ are after EVA...!」

144:5986.en: 「I'll protect it, other Earth or not!」

144:6025.en: 「You won't use that power any more!」

144:6060.en: 「That's... a power you must not use!」

144:6130.en: 「Before that bloodlust consumes us,\nI have to do something...!」

144:6279.en: 「If that one leads the $$サイデリアル$$...!」

144:6320.en: 「If only you'd used that power\nfor something else...!」

144:6373.en: 「I can't let that person\nhave the $$スフィア$$...!」

144:6533.en: 「Telling us nothing, and just\nforcing the results on us...!」

144:6631.en: 「I won't forgive you...!\nYou were deceiving us!」

144:6791.en: 「In the end, I may never be able\nto do anything... But still...!」

144:6854.en: 「Protect the future...!\nThat's what our fight is for!」

144:6946.en: 「That's why we came all this way...!」

144:7086.en: 「I won't let you get any closer!」

144:7163.en: 「I can use it like this, too...!」

144:7469.en: 「I should still be able to catch up!」

144:7496.en: 「I can't just keep taking a beating!」

144:7585.en: 「I have to do something on my own...!」

144:7716.en: 「$$綾波$$...! I'll take it from here!」

144:7939.en: 「I won't let them take out $$トップレス$$!」

144:7972.en: 「$$ガンバスター$$ is humanity's hope!」

144:8044.en: 「They trusted me. I have to try...!」

144:8339.en: 「What would $$ミサト$$ do\nin a situation like this...」

144:8538.en: 「$$カヲル$$ is fighting with me too...」

144:8577.en: 「I have to do it...!\nEven without $$ミサト$$...!」

144:8809.en: 「It wasn't as bad as I thought.」

144:9096.en: 「I must turn this bad run around...!」

144:9170.en: 「No matter how much it hurts...\nI have to keep fighting...!」

144:9347.en: 「No, if I take another hit, then...!」

144:9532.en: 「$$カヲル$$! At least you, get out!」

144:9569.en: 「No...! Is this as far as I go...?!」

144:9682.en: 「Huh... But I was just getting the hang of it...」

144:9729.en: 「Good night, $$カヲル$$. Good night, players, too.」

144:9794.en: 「Playing with $$カヲル$$ was fun, first time in a while.」

144:9879.en: 「But... is it okay? You only watch me play, $$カヲル$$」

144:9963.en: 「$$綾波$$, if you're free, want to play with me?」

144:10006.en: 「No, it's not like it's an order...」
